newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Ansett seen in Air NZ, SIA link - paper.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Ansett seen in Air NZ, SIA link - paper.

text.p: Australian airline Ansett International is expected to secure an alliance with Air New Zealand and Singapore Airlines Ltd, the Australian Financial Review newspaper reported on Monday.
The report said the alliance would pose a threat to the tie-up between Qantas Airways Ltd and British Airways Plc on routes between Australia and Europe.
The paper said the airlines were not discussing an exchange of equity. Ansett is owned 50/50 by News Corp Ltd and Air New Zealand.
Quoting sources from Canberra, the report said senior federal government officials had been briefed about the alliance and was due to be announced sometime in May.
"The arrangement is understood to involve plans for joint pricing by three airlines on routes linking Australia with Europe via Singapore," the Australian Financial Review reported.
The paper said the arrangements would be subject to approval from the Australian Competition and Consumer Commission (ACCC).
The report said the new alliance would be similar to the alliance between Qantas and British Airways which sees those airlines pool resources and services.
Qantas is 25 percent owned by British Airways.
